"'''Pinky'''" was the nickname of a [[Tuttin System Security Force]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on [[Tuttin IV]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Ryley Ancum]] had been evaluated by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Intelligence]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Keth Beamis]], and he dismissed [[Onjo Fegel]], Pinky and another security force officer approached Keth, questioning him about [[Maiferri Tag]], who had been arrested on charge of espionage. Both officers took Ryler and Keth to the [[Admin Centre]] and placed the two in separate cells despite their protests.<ref name="GC6" />
